title: AcceptResult
description: What a accept Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result accept. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

met.description: Branched on: false makes the outcome unmet; null is unchecked.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
